text:
Anya: Quick idea — what if next Wednesday we do a Bagel Bar + 20-min lunchtime improv micro-show? 
Mike: Big yes. Bagels + light improv sounds hilarious and low-effort :grin:
Kai: Love it. Rooftop or breakroom? Rooftop might be noisy but vibe is better.
Devon: Rooftop if weather holds. If not, Conf C works.
Lina: I can bring lox and a few spreads (lox + shmear). Any dietary notes?
Anya: Awesome Lina 🙌. We'll do a sign-up for spreads/vegan options. Can people react to volunteer: :+1: if attending, :heart: if bringing food, :raised_hands: if you want to perform improv.
Mike: Reacted. I can perform a 5-min sketch if needed.
Kai: I can DJ a tiny playlist. Also happy to bring a few gluten-free bagels.
Devon: Count me as attendee, not performing. Quick logistics: propose 12:30–1:15 (short on purpose).
Anya: Plan: 12:25 doors, 12:30 eat, 12:50 two 10-min improv bits, 1:10 wrap. Will post calendar invite.
EventsBot: I've created a provisional calendar event and added the RSVPs channel. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd1234
Lina: FYI I need access to a toaster oven — is there one in the kitchen?
Mike: There's a toaster oven in pantry next to the Keurig.
Devon: Also, can we borrow two folding chairs from Ops?
Anya: Yup, pinged Ops. 
Lina: I'll bring extras in case.
Anya: Sweet. Final ask: if you want to perform, drop a 1-line idea here so we can organize order.
Mike: I'll do a quick 'job interview gone wrong' sketch.
Kai: I'll soundtrack.
Devon: I'll be audience warm-up.
EventsBot: Reminder scheduled for next Tuesday at 10:00 to finalize sign-ups.
Anya: Thanks team! Short, fun, and bagel-y :bagel:
